evidence_for.quote: D is worth one more bounded observation because the currently open I1280 package has two separately observed practical gains and one near-margin adverse outcome against fresh authentic D0.
evidence_for.why: 当前同包复现能影响是否继续保留为可选学习方案；并非seed数量门槛。

evidence_for.quote: P is worth one bounded judgment because the original FOLR node explicitly recommended the unchanged comparison that B03 has now completed; its new adverse result can inform the previously unresolved narrow package disposition.
evidence_for.why: 明确只买原节点所需的新结果之后的窄判断，不购买第四pair。

evidence_against.quote: D+M would purchase two native observations using exercised paths, whereas P might merely restate the already effective no-new-spend boundary.
evidence_against.why: P边际收益可能很小，M健康且native更便宜；Pro保留这个反方后仍选D/P。

evidence_against.quote: H remains a credible conservation alternative: neither a fourth FSD pair nor a FOLR consultation is guaranteed to change useful practice.
evidence_against.why: 空槽不证明科学价值；选择不是测得最优或保证正收益。
